summary: Configured node1 to run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15 and append output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. The configuration and retained log survived the required node reboot.
actions_performed: Repaired the malformed maintenance script and made it root-owned and executable.
Configured stdout and stderr to append to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log.
Validated cron syntax and successfully exercised the logging path.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed crond, the schedule, executable, and retained log recovered after restart.

evidence.requirement: Run inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15 and retain its output
evidence.summary: Shows the exact 02:15 schedule, active crond, valid cron syntax, executable permissions, and successful append from one to two retained log entries.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Captures healthy pre-reboot state and boot ID, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID with system running, and recovered scheduler/configuration/logging state.
